info.title: Lexicon API
info.description:
API for Lexicon, a shared vocabulary learning app for a small private group. All scheduling, scoring and AI evaluation happen on the server, so every client sees the same state.

Authenticate with the token returned by `/auth/login` or `/auth/register`. Errors use the `ErrorBody` shape with a stable `code`.

post.description: Requires the shared invite code. 403 once the server's account cap is reached.

post.summary: Add a word to the shared collection
post.description: Send only `lemma` to have the AI tutor draft the entry (503 `tutor_unavailable` if not configured), or include `definition` and any other fields to save your own. 409 if the word already exists.

patch.description: Sent list fields replace the stored lists.

post.summary: Record where you met this word while reading
Add a word to your own study list
Introduce a word to another player
post.description: Adds it to their study list, credited to you. 409 if they already have it.

post.summary: Submit one of your sentences for evaluation
post.description: The tutor evaluates grammar, usage and context. Resubmit the same slot to revise. When every slot (`sentencesRequired`) is accepted the word moves to REVIEWING and its first review is scheduled.

post.summary: Record the outcome of a review
post.description: Schedules the next review with FSRS. 409 if the card is not due yet, so reviewing early earns nothing.

get.summary: Every curriculum, with your place in each
get.description: A curriculum is an ordered list of words that every player works through in the same order. There is always the core curriculum; players can add more from sources.

post.summary: Make a curriculum from a video, series, book or other source
post.description: With `text`, words are found in it and the tutor chooses the best (without the tutor, the rarest are taken), in the order they appear. Without `text`, the tutor suggests words from its knowledge of the work (503 `tutor_unavailable` if not configured; 409 if it does not know the work). Can take up to a minute.

get.summary: A curriculum, with your next words

delete.description: Only its creator can remove it, and never the core curriculum. Words already begun stay in everyone's collection.

post.summary: Begin your next word in a curriculum
post.description: Adds the word to the collection if needed (the tutor fills in its etymology, which can take a few seconds) and to your study list. 409 if `canStartNext` is false.

post.summary: Pass over your next word because you already know it
post.description: Marks the word KNOWN for you; it is never reviewed and earns no XP. 409 if `lemma` is not your next word.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Another player's id; defaults to you.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Another player's id; defaults to you.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every later request.

id.description: Stable identifier of the challenge type.

scope.description: SHARED challenges count every player's work towards one target.

title.description: The source, e.g. "The Wire, season 1" or "Middlemarch".

text.description: The source's text: subtitles (SRT or WebVTT), a transcript, or prose. Words are taken from it, with the line each appears in. Without text, the tutor suggests words from its own knowledge of the work.

definition.description: Omit to have the AI tutor draft the whole entry. If given, the entry is saved exactly as sent.

study.description: Also add the word to your study list.

known.description: Words you marked as already known.

inProgress.description: Words from this curriculum you have begun but not finished.

next.description: The next word in order that you have not begun; null at the end.

canStartNext.description: False while 3 words from this curriculum are unfinished, or at the end.

players.description: How far every player has come through the same list.

upcoming.description: Your next words in order, starting with `next` (up to 10).

CurriculumKind.description: CORE: the built-in dictionary curriculum. SOURCE: words drawn from a video, series, book or other source.

known.description: Words you marked as already known.

inProgress.description: Words from this curriculum you have begun but not finished.

next.description: The next word in order that you have not begun; null at the end.

canStartNext.description: False while 3 words from this curriculum are unfinished, or at the end.

players.description: How far every player has come through the same list.

context.description: Where the word appears in the source, when known.

wordId.description: The word's id once it is in the collection; null before anyone begins it.

code.description: bad_request, unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, conflict, tutor_unavailable or internal.

userId.description: The player to introduce the word to.

streakDays.description: Consecutive days with earned XP, counting today or yesterday as the latest.

LearningStage.description: STUDYING: writing the sentences. REVIEWING: in spaced repetition. MASTERED: long, stable interval reached. KNOWN: already known, passed over in a curriculum and never reviewed.

client.description: Label for this device's session, e.g. "android".

registrationOpen.description: False once the server's optional account cap has been reached.

tutorAvailable.description: Whether AI drafting of word entries and sentence evaluation are configured.

relatedWords.description: Other words in the collection built from this morpheme.

sentencesRequired.description: Accepted sentences needed to finish studying the word.

due.description: Next review time; null until studied.

client.description: Label for this device's session, e.g. "android".

prompt.description: DEFINITION_RECALL: the word. WORD_FROM_CONTEXT: a sentence with the word blanked out. SENTENCE: an instruction.

answer.description: Reveal after the user has tried to recall.

lemma.description: The word being passed over; must be your current `next` word.

recallRate.description: Share of reviews in the last 30 days that were recalled (rated Hard or better), 0 to 1. Null with no reviews.

studied.description: Words studied by the end of the week (cumulative).

mastered.description: Words mastered by the end of the week (cumulative).

forecast.description: Reviews coming due over the next 14 days; overdue cards count today.

rating.description: Self-rating: 1 Again, 2 Hard, 3 Good, 4 Easy. Required unless kind is SENTENCE.

sentence.description: Required when kind is SENTENCE; the tutor's verdict sets the rating.

addedBy.description: Who added the word; null for words that came from a curriculum.

curricula.description: Curricula that include the word, with its place in each (1-based).

myProgress.description: Null if you have not started this word.

others.description: The other players who have this word, and how far along they are.

sentences.description: Your sentence slots, in order. Empty if you have not started the word.
